messages:
alex.ae: Quick sync 1: Skyline demo scheduled tomorrow 09:30 PT. Need final sign-off on load profile, latency SLOs, and whether they require customer-managed keys for the fallback Dedicated window.

maria.eng: Draft load profile: baseline steady 120 qps for 15m, then 5m linear ramp to 500 qps, followed by three 10m bursts at 500 qps separated by 2m cool-downs. Model: redwood/gpt-small-2048-int8, max_tokens ~300, seq_len 512. Target batching: 32 (max_batch_ms=10). Expected hosted numbers: p50 ~40ms, p95 ~120ms, p99 ~250-320ms (tails vary with KV cache hit rate).

chris.ops: Networking note: Skyline will test from their infra (IP ranges provided in separate email). We'll need IP allowlist entries and 2x egress subnets. Testing across regions: us-west1 primary, us-east1 for failover.

alex.ae: Procurement flagged KMS/HSM requirement for Dedicated fallback and asked about audit log retention. irene.sec, can you confirm what we can offer for Dedicated vs Private?

irene.sec: For Dedicated and Private we support customer KMS (AWS/GCP KMS). If they require HSM-backed keys, that is satisfied by their cloud KMS (bring-your-own-key). We can export audit logs to their SIEM and configure retention. We'll need their KMS ARN/service account and IAM binding before the run if they want CMK enforced.

maria.eng: Performance note: int8 gives cost savings but slightly higher p99 variance. We can configure routing to send a small canary slice to a higher-capacity variant to absorb tail spikes. Also recommend enabling KV prefix caching for their workload to reduce repetitive context cost.

devon.sre: Runbook excerpt:
```
- 09:20 PT: smoke test against /v1/generate from canary host
- 09:30 PT: start load generator (see k6 sample below)
- Every 2m: log p50/p95/p99; if p99 > 400ms for 3 consecutive windows -> shift 20% traffic to fallback model
- If KV cache hit rate < 60% for 4m, reduce batch_size to 16 to avoid queueing
- Capture GPU util, tok/s, errors per minute in prometheus/grafana
```

alex.ae: Customer asked for a reproducible load command for their infra team. maria, can you add a k6 snippet?

maria.eng: Sample k6 command and script header:
```
# run from their load runner
k6 run --vus 400 --duration 20m --out json=skyline_run.json --summary-export=summary.json load_skyline.js

// load_skyline.js - pseudocode
// call POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
// include batch_size 32, seq_len 512, model redwood/gpt-small-2048-int8
```

chris.ops: For multi-region test they plan to start us-west1 then failover traffic to us-east1 at the last burst. We'll pre-warm both regions and pin DNS TTL low.

alex.ae: Pricing asks from Skyline: (A) hosted POC only, (B) hosted + short Dedicated fallback (8h window), (C) monthly Dedicated commit. Any roughs for the deck?

maria.eng: Back-of-envelope: assume avg tokens/request 300. For the planned test (~120 qps steady + bursts to 500 qps for total ~40 minutes of heavy activity) ballpark tokens ~80-100M. At hosted list $0.005 per 1k tokens that's ~$400-500 for hosted. Dedicated short window: add reserved 8h pool overhead ~ $1.1k plus incremental compute; monthly small Dedicated pool ~ $24k-$30k depending on GPU type and reserved capacity. I'll run exact calc with their average prompt size and desired tail targets.

irene.sec: One enterprise blocker: Skyline legal requires SOC2 Type II and an EU data residency clause for EU traffic. We have SOC2; for residency we can offer Private in their EU region or Dedicated with data plane in-region. Legal is working on standard clause language.

devon.sre: I'll add a canary routing rule in the demo config: 90% primary int8 model, 10% fallback large-model for first 5 minutes. If error rate or latencies are bad we'll flip more traffic. I'll be on-call during the run.

load-bot: Reminder scheduled: Skyline-demo-load @ 2026-06-18T09:30:00-07:00 created. 30m reminder set.

alex.ae: Outstanding owners: (1) KMS ARN + IAM binding (Skyline) -> irene.sec, (2) Finalized perf numbers + precise token cost -> maria.eng, (3) Runbook + routing config -> devon.sre, (4) Legal residency clause follow-up -> chris.ops/legal.

irene.sec: I'll reach out to Skyline for KMS details and PI handling requirements.

maria.eng: I'll produce a conservative p99 estimate and a pricing sheet with token ranges by EOD.

devon.sre: I'll finalize the runbook and health checks; will post the Grafana dashboard link before the run.

alex.ae: Great. If no objections we'll ship this plan. :thumbsup:
